articles.title: The Oyster Helpers Trying to Bring Back Chesapeake Bay
articles.summary: Oysters filter Chesapeake Bay water and shelter other creatures, but their numbers fell sharply. A Kent Island resident, his neighbours and robot researchers are working to bring them back.

articles.title: Election Night, Hour by Hour: Polls Close and Counting Begins
articles.summary: A guide to Tuesday's election night: polls close in waves from 7 p.m. to 1 a.m. Eastern, close Senate races may decide control, and some counting could last days or weeks.

articles.title: Families Reunite After Evacuation From Oleshky
articles.summary: Residents from Russian-occupied Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory under a localized ceasefire, travelling through Russia and Belarus. Relatives and aid groups waited to welcome them on Saturday.
